visualCharacteristics.purpose: Product detail tabs (e.g. Overview / Features / Specifications / Resources) with one panel per tab
visualCharacteristics.description: Centered horizontal tab bar of uppercase labels; the active tab carries a thick underline. Below 900px the tab bar becomes a 'Filter By' select. Each panel is a rich-text column; an optional image sits beside the text on desktop (stacked on mobile). Panel tables without images (e.g. Specifications label | list, Connections name | description | link) render as row-separated data tables; image tables keep the side-by-side layout. Vidyard links in a panel render as a poster with a play overlay and play inline on click.

contentPattern.structure: One row per tab item: title (plain text) | image (optional reference + alt) | text (rich text: headings, paragraphs, lists). Accessible ARIA tabs pattern (tablist/tab/tabpanel, arrow/Home/End keys). In the text, a paragraph holding only a play.vidyard.com link becomes an inline video (an image-only paragraph right before it is used as the poster). A URL hash or in-page link matching the slug of a tab title (#overview, #specifications, ...) activates that tab and scrolls to the block.

usage.description: REMISOL Advance product page (Overview tab); DxA 5000 Fit product page (Overview / Specifications / Documents / Connections / Configurations, reached from the hero jump links); intended for product detail pages with several tabs.

reuseGuidance: Use for product detail tab sets with rich-text panels. Use tabs-products for the Figma-style label/text/image product tabs with eyebrow and CTA.
